name: MCP Server for MySQL (benborla)
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C3, C4, C5, C6, C7; partly meets C1, C8, C10; does not meet C2, C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @benborla29/mcp-server-mysql@2.0.9 names the repository `git+https://github.com/benborla/mcp-server-mysql.git`. The record carries no provenance attestation (`dist.attestations` is absent).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub's security-policy page for the repository says "No security policy detected" and offers no private vulnerability reporting; the README names no channel for security reports (searched for: security@, vulnerability, responsible disclosure, report security).

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 2.0.9 is dated 2026-06-19; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-07-27; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-07-27.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The README describes the server as read-only by default, with write operations switched on by environment flags. Quoted: “**Read-only by default** — write operations opt-in via env flags”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: Database credentials are supplied through environment variables. Quoted: “"MYSQL_PASS": "your_password",”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.15.1. Lower-bound version 1.15.1 of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (npm) was published on 2025-07-10, between 12 and 24 months before 2026-11-14.
